title: ‘BTS World Tour ARIRANG in Busan’: Here’s Where to Buy Tickets to Limited Homecoming Screening Online
summary: BTS' Busan livestream is set to hit the big screen for just one day only. Buy tickets online.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

On Saturday, June 13, BTS’ official anniversary date, the group will be heading to Busan, South Korea, for a homecoming show, and BTS ARMY across the globe are invited to watch.

The boy band is hosting a global live viewing of their Busan Asiad Main Stadium gig. The “Hooligan” singers will be performing at the venue on Friday, June 12, and Saturday, June 13, with the livestreaming of their event taking place during the Saturday show. Tickets to watch the BTS limited-screening are available now at Fandango .

get bts WORLD TOUR 'ARIRANG' IN BUSAN Film Tickets

To find a theater showing the homecoming stint near you, check out the BTS live viewing site .

This is a much cheaper and more accessible option for eager fans who don’t have the money to spend on the boy groups’ world tour tickets . Some venues have gone up in pricing, around $3,000 for a single ticket.

Fans who aren’t local to South Korea will finally get the chance to see Jin, Suga, J-Hope, RM, Jimin, V, and Jung Kook up close as if they were right there in the theater with them. The Saturday Busan gig takes place on BTS’ 13th anniversary. Milestones like this don’t happen every day, and they certainly aren’t always available to watch via livestream.

BTS World Tour ‘Arirang’ in Busan: Live Viewing

Buy Now at fandango

This is a special moment for members Jimin and Jung Kook, since they are originally from Busan. V and Suga are from Daegu, RM is from Ilsan, J-Hope is from Gwangju and Jin is from Gwacheon.

Fandango currently has an exclusive $55 bundle available for the live anniversary gig. The “Special Day Exclusive Bundle” includes a single ticket to the June 13 showing, along with a cool holographic poster. Learn more about the Fandango-only bundle here .

Meanwhile, BTS just wrapped up the first North American leg of the ARIRANG tour at Allegiant Stadium in Las Vegas on May 28. They will return to North America on Aug. 1 with a show in East Rutherford, N.J., at MetLife Stadium.

“We’re proud to continue our role in BTS’ comeback of the decade with this live viewing from Busan,” Trafalgar CEO Marc Allenby said in a statement. “Marking the anniversary of the group’s debut, this special day gives fans across the globe a chance to celebrate, wherever they may be. Together with our exhibition partners, we’re excited to make this event truly unmissable.”
